import pytest
import io
from rich.console import Console
from rich.screen import Screen

def test_double_width_char_in_modal_screen():
    console = Console(file=io.StringIO(), width=60, height=11)
    screen = Screen("青春サツバツ論", style="on blue")
    console.print(screen)
    output = console.file.getvalue()
    assert len(output.splitlines()[0]) == 60
